title: Linux release binaries built by GitHub Actions
objective: A workflow builds `intent` and `intentd` for x86_64 and aarch64 Linux, packages them with the support payload, proves the packaged `intent --version` runs at an old distribution floor, and keeps each package as a workflow artifact.
body:
## As built

- `.github/workflows/linux-release.yml` builds both musl triples, packages them with the support payload and smokes each in `oraclelinux:7-slim`; satisfied from run 39854556183.
- The binaries are static against musl, so no glibc floor applies.
- `intent-support.tar.gz` serves Linux unchanged.

Nothing is open.
